'''Fixer 308''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served in the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around [[3642 BBY]] she was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] at the [[Frostwake Outpost]] in the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]]. She devised a plan to cripple the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] once and for all by attacking a meeting of their leaders, a plan that a fellow Imperial carried out.
